// diagnostic

E3203

`{ty}` is not a C-compatible type for a foreign function parameter or return.

What

`{ty}` is not a C-compatible type for a foreign function parameter or return.

Why

`#Extern` / `#Bindgen` functions must use types with a stable C ABI at the edge.

Fix

use scalars, `String`, or a struct with C layout; pointers only through the gated tier.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3203: tests/ui/cffi_abi_function_value.stderr.

Error [E3203]: `fn(I32) I32` is not a C-compatible type for a foreign function parameter or return.
  --> tests/ui/cffi_abi_function_value.jet:8:19
    |
  8 |     callback :: c.ping
    |                   ^^^^
 Why: `#Extern` / `#Bindgen` functions must use types with a stable C ABI at the edge.
 Fix: use scalars, `String`, or a struct with C layout; pointers only through the gated tier.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3203

Error [E0116]: `callback` doesn't hand back a value
  --> tests/ui/cffi_abi_function_value.jet:9:11
    |
  9 |     print(callback(1))
    |           ^^^^^^^^
 Why: a call is a value only when its function declares a result after the parameter list
 Fix: inside an arm, wrap the call in `{ … }`; otherwise put `callback` on its own line, or declare it as `fn callback(…) Type -> …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0116
